After any candidate result has been inspected NO frozen item may change; a change is a protocol violation and is disclosed as one. A discovered defect is reported and fixed in a new, separately-dated freeze, never patched into this run.

comparison_decision_rule.authority: ruling SR-LIFE-EVENT-COMPARISON (a)-(c), owner-surrogate; branch kalayantra/freeze-5.0 off campaign-coordination; the Stage-2 seal and the comparison record carry the shas of both freezes; main untouched
comparison_decision_rule.rule_text: Ruling SR-LIFE-EVENT-COMPARISON. (b) STRICT is the verdict: an unsearched region = UNMATCHED; horizon_only is reported beside it, labelled diagnostic, plus the count of events in unsearched regions. (c) MAPPED = inside a qualified window of its class AND peak within the protocol's timing tolerance (45 days, protocol v2.3 §6.2/§6.4) AND valence agrees; PARTLY is split into timing-fail vs valence-fail; UNMATCHED = in no qualified window of its class; reported per class and in total, and the page reports the false-positive side (T-FP endpoints per class vs allowances).
comparison_decision_rule.strict: an event in an unsearched region (any touched (class, year) cell with no ledger partition, a horizon that does not cover the year, or a non-null unsearched_reason) is UNMATCHED; this is the VERDICT
comparison_decision_rule.horizon_only: same rules but an unsearched_reason alone does not unsearch a cell (the horizon must still cover the year); reported beside strict, LABELLED DIAGNOSTIC, never the verdict; plus the count of events in unsearched regions under each policy
comparison_decision_rule.MAPPED: inside a qualified window of its class (stored si not NULL; shares >= 1 IST day with the event's scored span) AND peak within the timing tolerance (45 days, protocol §6.2/§6.4; error per §5) AND the stored outcome_valence_for_native agrees with the class polarity (adverse for the nine frozen adverse classes, else favourable) — all three on ONE window
comparison_decision_rule.PARTLY: an overlapping qualified window exists but none is MAPPED; split PARTLY_timing_fail (a window agrees in valence, none in time) vs PARTLY_valence_fail (a window in time, none agrees) — plus PARTLY_both_fail where neither holds
comparison_decision_rule.UNMATCHED: in no qualified window of its class (or, under the policy, in an unsearched region)
comparison_decision_rule.reported: per class and totals (and by tier), for strict (verdict) and horizon_only (diagnostic); events in unsearched regions; the false-positive side = frozen-scorer T-FP per adverse class vs allowance and the gain band
comparison_decision_rule.personal_data: the per-event table lives only under /Users/Dev/scratch.noindex/claude/madhav/, never in git; the counts file carries counts only
